card.title: Power Looks Good
card.instruction: Act fascinated by confident behavior; imitate it closely while resenting how naturally it seems to work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your pause silenced the committee. I'll copy it for my report. Annoying how easily that works for you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was holding back a cough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even your cough commands respect. How long did you hold it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like your attention. Was that your exact tone? You make four words look hereditary.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 admires and resents the commanding pause, A3 asks to copy even its accidental duration, and A5 practices the offered words while envying effortless tone.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's cough correction makes A3 envy the cough; B4's usable attention request becomes A5's spoken imitation and tone comparison.

relationship.evidence: B2 demystifies the pause and B4 gives A an ordinary usable alternative.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's exact sentence yet still attributes its effectiveness to B's natural inheritance.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's hereditary four words follows the exact wording B4 supplied and sustains the resentment.
